name: P-adic linear regression encoding for constraint solving

mentions.name: P-adic linear regression encoding for constraint solving
mentions.description: This research result proves that constraint solving problems can be encoded as p-adic linear regression problems, so machine learning optimization techniques can be used to obtain exact answers. The paper is being reformatted for submission to a journal.
mentions.source_excerpt: I just proved that constraint solving problems can be encoded as p-adic linear regression problems[+], and that therefore we can use machine learning optimisation techniques to get exact answers.
